# Hypothesis tests

::: callout-note
## $P$-values

Introduce $P$-value, but do not force decision as to whether or not to "reject" the null hypothesis. 
Then separately talk about making decisions as to whether to accept or reject,
$\alpha$, $\beta$, type-I and type-II errors, and so on.
:::

::: callout-note
## $P$-values vs. confidence intervals

Expain that in many cases a $P$-value is not necessary,
because the confidence interval tells you all you need to know.
:::
